           VERBENA URTICAEFOLIA

         Blue Vervain

        (VERBENA)


Affects the skin and   nervous system  .
        Nervous depression, weakness and irritation and spasms. Promotes the absorption of blood and
        allays pain in bruises. Vesicular erysipelas. Passive congestion and intermittent fever. One
        of the remedies for Poison-oak.   Epilepsy  , insomnia,
        mental exhaustion. In epilepsy, it   brightens up the patient's
        mental powers   and helps the constipation.



Dose.--  Single dose of the tincture. In epilepsy must be
        continued for a long time. Verbena in the form of a tea as a diuretic drink is used by
        Vannier (Paris) to aid elimination in tubercular therapy.
